The Mission

Science meets
gastronomy

Cooking is the act of turning nature into culture — the very mechanism that enabled the omnivorous human diet. Recipes are the cultural capsules that encode elaborate cooking protocols for evoking sensory satiation.

As we stand on the verge of an epidemic of diet-linked disorders, it is critically important to investigate the culinary correlates of dietary elements — probing their association with sensory responses and consequences for nutrition and health.

RecipeDB2, built by Prof. Ganesh Bagler's CoSyLab at IIIT Delhi, is the world's first computational gastronomy platform that bridges recipes, ingredients, flavor science (FlavorDB), and nutritional profiles (USDA DietRx) at scale.

Capabilities

Everything you need
to decode cuisine

🔍

Multi-Dimensional Search

Search by cuisine, region, country, recipe name, ingredients used or excluded, cooking process, and utensils — all in one intelligent query engine.

🧬

Nutritional Profiling

Every recipe is linked to detailed USDA nutritional data. Filter by calories, carbohydrates, protein, and fat thresholds to find diet-perfect recipes.

🌍

Global Cuisine Atlas

7 continents, 32 geo-cultural regions, 99 countries, 34 states — the most geographically comprehensive recipe database in the world.

📊

Analytics Dashboard

Visualize average caloric distributions by continent, macro-nutrient weights, dietary profiles, and more through an interactive analytics panel.

⚡

API Console

An integrated developer playground lets you query the RecipeDB2 REST API directly, inspect responses, and copy cURL commands with zero setup.

🥗

Nutri-Planner

Set daily macro targets — calories, carbs, protein, fat — and let RecipeDB2's solver recommend matching recipes tailored to your dietary goals.

Food Science Lab & Flavor Galaxy

Explore our interactive, physics-based network of flavor chemical compounds. Dive deep into the Ingredient Flavor Galaxy to visualize shared flavor profiles between staple ingredients across the globe, or use the Global Cuisine Atlas to map out authentic geographic culinary relationships.
